title: Persist orders in Motoko backend and show post-checkout order confirmation

requirements.text: Implement backend order persistence in the single Motoko actor: when a user submits checkout/transaction details, create and store an Order containing (1) generated order id, (2) line items (product name, unit price in ₹, quantity), (3) computed total in ₹, (4) buyer Minecraft username, (5) UPI payment reference/UTR, and (6) timestamp.

quotes: add a transaction page in view cart soo they can buy add only upi option to buy stuff
add add to Cart where it is written rupees

acceptanceCriteria: A stable Order type/model exists in the backend with fields: orderId, items[{name, unitPriceInr, quantity}], totalInr, minecraftUsername, upiUtr, createdAt (timestamp).
A new order can be created and stored without losing data across page refreshes and subsequent calls (i.e., persisted in canister state).
The backend generates a unique orderId for each submitted order.
The backend computes totalInr from the provided line items (unitPriceInr * quantity) and stores the computed value with the order.

requirements.text: Expose backend canister methods for checkout flow: (1) createOrder(payload) -> orderId and (2) getOrderById(orderId) -> order details for confirmation display.

quotes: add a transaction page in view cart soo they can buy

acceptanceCriteria: There is a callable canister update method to create an order and return the generated orderId.
There is a callable canister query (or update) method to fetch a stored order by id, returning all stored fields.
If getOrderById is called with an unknown orderId, the method returns an explicit 'not found' result (does not trap).

requirements.text: Wire the frontend transaction/checkout submission to the backend createOrder method, and after successful submission show an order confirmation view that displays: order id, Minecraft username, UPI UTR/reference, purchased items (name, quantity, unit price in ₹), and final total in ₹.

add only upi option to buy stuff

acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the transaction form calls the backend createOrder method with the cart line items and buyer details.
After createOrder succeeds, the UI navigates to (or renders) a confirmation state/view that shows the returned orderId and the full order summary.
The confirmation view fetches the order details from the backend via getOrderById (or uses returned data plus a fetch-by-id) and renders values in English.
All money amounts are displayed using the ₹ symbol and INR values.
The cart is cleared only after an order is successfully created (not on failed submission).

constraints: Keep all Motoko logic in a single main actor (no multi-canister or multi-actor backend design).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutablePaths; compose existing UI components instead.
Do not add any non-UPI payment method options to checkout UI.
nonGoals: Processing payments automatically (no payment gateway integration).
Generating UPI QR codes or deep links.
